pages.text: Cars go $(l)15% faster$() on $(item)Asphalt$(), and their tires wear slower. $(item)Road Paint$() marks it: right-click the air to pick a marking (center lines, lane and edge lines, stop lines, crosswalks, arrows), then the asphalt. Paint the same thing again to scrape it off.
Street Poles hold up traffic lights, signs and street lamps, which come on at dusk.
